description: This file defines build configurations and device-specific settings for Ubiquiti devices within an OpenWRT build system. It includes device definitions, image generation commands, and custom build routines tailored for different hardware variants.

classes.name: Device
classes.description: Base class for defining Ubiquiti device configurations with common properties and build routines.

methods.name: Build/mkubntimage
methods.description: Build rule to create Ubiquiti firmware image with specific parameters.

methods.name: Build/mkubntimage2
methods.description: Build rule to create a second type of Ubiquiti firmware image, possibly for specific device variants.

methods.name: Build/mkubntimage-split
methods.description: Build rule to split firmware images into chunks suitable for certain Ubiquiti devices expecting kernel and root filesystem separately.
